# Freewill Ridez

> Freewill Ridez (also styled FREEWILLRIDEZ) is a motorcycle crew and content brand out of Pontiac, Michigan. It hosts group rides that have drawn 75+ bikes eight months straight, posts riding content on TikTok as @freewillflow, and runs a numbered-volume streetwear merch line.

Content reflects the crew's own riding. A movement: no drama, everybody rides home.

This site was compiled by SpartanH2 (https://spartanh2.com/) and The Moto Legion (https://themotolegion.com/), a southeast Michigan motorcycle content collective.

## About

- [Home](https://freewillridez.com/): Central hub — links, latest TikTok videos, and the merch line
- [About](https://freewillridez.com/about.html): The story of the crew, the rides, and the drops

## Content types

- Motorcycle group rides hosted in and around Pontiac, Michigan
- Sportbike riding content on TikTok
- Merch drops: numbered volumes (For The Culture, Till Death Do Us Part, Detroit Motor City, Living Ghost, King of the Streets) plus Truly Wanted, Public Enemy Number One, and the Michigan Central box logo

## Location

- Pontiac, Michigan, United States. Michigan Central Station is the crew's signature backdrop.

## Platforms

- [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@freewillflow): Ride and culture clips
- [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1289920255732814): FREEWILLRIDEZ GROUP RIDEZ — all meet-ups, routes, and ride info land here first

## Merch

- [Store](https://freewillridez.store): The official Freewill Ridez line
